profile_text.body:
Netflix Inc describes itself as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. The company states that members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. It reports over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.

The available material does not describe any AI-specific products for Netflix. The company's website text focuses on its streaming entertainment service rather than artificial intelligence offerings.

Netflix Inc is a public company traded under the ticker NFLX, headquartered in Los Gatos, California, with SEC Central Index Key 0001065280. The available data lists 281 legal exposure entries in California and no litigation cases. No MCP servers are listed for the company.
